headline: HYUKOH release '33', first full album in 6 years
sub: 14 tracks and 73 minutes of music, out now
source: Source: Dooroo Dooroo Artist Company via Korean media
caption:
HYUKOH are back with '33', their first full-length album in six years.

The band released the 14-track, 73-minute record on November 25 at 6 PM KST. Their agency says the album looks at the love that remains after loss and anxiety.

📌 Source: Dooroo Dooroo Artist Company, via Korean media (Yonhap News, PPSS, Joy News 24)
